name: CB Insights
description: Unleash Claude as your private markets research agent. Source companies, build market maps, draft investment memos, and monitor competitors — all powered by CB Insights' predictive intelligence. Tap into 11M+ double-validated company profiles, leading coverage of recent equity deals, proprietary taxonomies, unique scores, hidden signals, and over 20 years of bleeding-edge technology research to identify and analyze relevant, high-potential companies ahead of your competition. Built for corporate strategists seeking acquisition targets, VCs screening deal flow, and business development teams hunting new partners. If your work involves private companies, CB Insights delivers the insight you need to make your next move first.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CB Insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CB Insights to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.cbinsights.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CB Insights MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CB Insights lists 15 MCP tools, including api_chatcbi, api_rag, company_advanced_search, get_company_acquisitions, get_company_competitors, get_company_exits, get_company_funding, get_company_investments, get_company_investors, get_company_markets, get_company_news, and get_company_outlook.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CB Insights?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CB Insights in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does CB Insights MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: CB Insights requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CB Insights is developed by CB Insights. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
